state.description: State named in the form heading, e.g. 'Ohio'

county.description: County named in the form heading

license_number.description: The license or record number written in the 'No.' box

affidavit.description: The sworn application at the top of the form

applicant_name.description: The man who appeared and swore the affidavit, as written

intended_spouse_name.description: The woman named as the intended spouse, as written

intended_spouse_residence_county.description: County the form states she is a resident of

sworn_date.description: Date sworn and subscribed, as YYYY-MM-DD

probate_judge.description: Name of the probate judge, as written above 'PROBATE JUDGE'

deputy_clerk.description: Name written on the 'By ... Deputy Clerk' line

marriage_return.description: The MARRIAGE RETURN section certifying the ceremony took place

marriage_date.description: Date of the marriage, as YYYY-MM-DD

spouse_1.description: First name written in the return

spouse_2.description: Second name written in the return

officiant_title.description: What the officiant describes himself as, e.g. 'Minister of the Gospel'
